newsitem.title: USA: BPA power prices little changed through Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA power prices little changed through Monday.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Friday it left prices for surplus power delivered Saturday through Monday relatively unchanged.
BPA continued to offer up to 500 megawatts of firm power during a block of peak demand hours at $11.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and to $12.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Prices for firm off-peak power (hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) were unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries.
Prices for non-firm power during peak hours (0800-1000, 1800-2000 PST) were also unchanged at $14.00 (Northwest) and $15.00 (COB).
Non-firm shoulder hour (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200) offers were steady at $10.00 for Northwest and $11.00 for COB.
Non-firm prices for off-peak (0100-0500 and 2400 PST) hours were unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries.
BPA offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Saturday and Sunday at $6.00 per MWh for all deliveries and at $7.00 on Monday.
